concepts.name: Industry Night
concepts.who: Service workers, bartenders, dancers, staff from other spots
concepts.format: Late start (11pm+), drink specials, no cover with paystub or staff ID
concepts.drinks: The Shift Change (whiskey + cola), The Last Call (tequila sunrise), Bartender's Breakfast (Irish coffee), Well Drink Specials (50% off all well drinks), Beer + Shot Combo ($8), Jamison Special

concepts.name: Swingers & Poker Night
concepts.who: Swingers and open relationship couples. Mingle Mondays crowd (social, open-minded, looking to connect).
concepts.format: Poker runs 7pm–10pm as the icebreaker/early crowd draw. Swinger atmosphere takes over after 10pm. Cross-promotion with Adam & Eve or similar local adult retail — they promote in-store, we give them a vendor table.
concepts.drinks: The Royal Flush (layered red/purple/black cocktail), Pocket Aces (double shot special), The Swing (champagne + bourbon), Red Room (red velvet martini), Safe Word (sweet + spicy margarita), The Mingle (shared punch bowl for 2+)

concepts.name: Teddy Tuesdays
concepts.who: Gentleman / business owner / executive who doesn't have to worry about work on Tuesday
concepts.format: Lingerie night with a sophisticated, upscale vibe. Think Victoria's Secret runway meets speakeasy.
concepts.drinks: The Teddy (white chocolate + raspberry martini), Silk Sheets (vanilla vodka + cream), Lace & Leather (smoky mezcal + honey), Champagne Room (bottle service special), The Runway (glitter champagne cocktail), Black Lace (blackberry + gin + activated charcoal)
concepts.costuming: Entertainers in teddys and lingerie wear. More like a Victoria's Secret Runway Fashion Show

concepts.name: Girls Gone Wild Wednesdays
concepts.format: High-energy, exciting atmosphere. The 'in-crowd.' Essentially the gentleman's club version of a college night.
concepts.drinks: The Keg Stand (beer tower special), Jungle Juice (fruit punch + vodka), Body Shots (tequila + lime + salt), The Funnel (shared cocktail pitcher), Beach Bum (malibu + pineapple), Red Solo Cup (mixed drink in a giant cup), The Dorm Room (cheap beer bucket special)
concepts.games: Spring Break Type Games, Playstation Games (Mario Kart etc)

concepts.name: Chicks in Kicks
concepts.who: Sneakerhead culture — people who love a high energy, exciting atmosphere who have disposable income. The 'in-crowd.'
concepts.format: Throwbacks in all genres pre-2010. Sneaker culture night. Cross-promotion with local high-end sneaker stores — they promote with flyers in-store, we give them a booth to sell their shoes.
concepts.drinks: Sneakertini, My Adidas, The Air Force One, etc
concepts.costuming: Girls in cool sneakers with matching outfits, different shoe store each week with vendor table

concepts.name: Femme Fatale Fridays
concepts.who: People who love a high energy, exciting atmosphere who have disposable income. The 'in-crowd.' Music programming leans slightly towards EDM.
concepts.drinks: The Femme Fatale (dark rum + blackberry + gold leaf), Diamonds Are Forever (champagne + vodka + edible glitter), The Secret Agent (gin + cucumber + elderflower), Red Lipstick (red wine + bourbon + cherry), Silk & Dagger (sake + lychee + rose), The Executive (scotch + smoked orange peel + bitters)
concepts.costuming: Evening Gowns, Pencil Dresses, Fitted Suits. Think elegant and sexy (James Bond, female)

concepts.name: Late Night
concepts.who: The after-hours crowd — people who want to keep the party going when everything else closes
concepts.format: 2am–6am. Underground vibe. Guest DJs regularly from 3am–5am. The only spot to BE after 2am in Boise on Saturdays — full kitchen serving breakfast items. Higher cover charge ($15–$20 after 2am). Revenue from breakfast + cover.

concepts.name: Animal House
concepts.format: Carnival/Freak Show with drummers, aerialists, poi/LED performers, singers, choreographed dancers, freak show performances (light hearted), etc.
concepts.drinks: Bottle Specials on High End Liquors, Circus and Drummer inspired drinks, Animal themed drink special
concepts.costuming: Circus/Freak Show type costuming for show performers

promotionalIdeas.name: Monthly Podcast — 'The Late Shift'
promotionalIdeas.concept: Monthly podcast showcasing the music we play in the club, interviews with entertainers, guests, and music artists. Downloadable from designated website. Keeps us top-of-mind.
promotionalIdeas.format: 30–45 min episodes. Behind-the-scenes interviews, industry talk, entertainment culture, track highlights from Saturday nights.
promotionalIdeas.integration: Clips feed social media; influencers get podcast feature as comp; promotes upcoming events
promotionalIdeas.copyrightSolution: Use Mixcloud as primary host — they have blanket licenses for music. For podcast platforms: use short music clips (under 30 seconds) with commentary, or license-free/podcast-safe music for intro/outro. Interview segments and talking content are 100% original and copyright-free.
promotionalIdeas.notes: Need to verify: episode length, host (Eric vs rotating), production workflow, equipment budget

promotionalIdeas.name: Influencer Marketing Program
promotionalIdeas.concept: 20–30 local influencers activated per month. Free admission + guest passes + podcast feature as comp. No forced posts — authentic experience first.
promotionalIdeas.format: Discovery via Instagram/TikTok hashtags (#BoiseNightlife, #BoiseParty). Tiered: Micro (5K–15K) → Mid (15K–50K) → Macro (50K+)
promotionalIdeas.integration: Influencers attend events, post organically, get featured on podcast and social channels
promotionalIdeas.notes: Budget: $400/mo for comp admission + drinks. Need influencer tracking spreadsheet.

promotionalIdeas.name: Street Team Activation
promotionalIdeas.concept: Activate Ish's network (bars, bouncers, promoters). Comp structure: $5–10 per head for verified referrals. Target downtown bars at last call (1:30–2am).
promotionalIdeas.format: Flyers/cards with QR code to Instagram/podcast. Referral tracking sheet.
promotionalIdeas.distribution: Downtown Boise bars: The Bastion, Neurolux, other 2am-close spots
promotionalIdeas.integration: Drives late-night crowd to SRB after other bars close. Especially effective for Saturday Late Night.
promotionalIdeas.notes: Budget: $300/mo for street team incentives. Need QR landing page.

promotionalIdeas.name: Content Creation & Social Media
promotionalIdeas.concept: Behind-the-scenes, crowd moments, DJ highlights, influencer collabs. Daily stories + 3–5 posts/week on Instagram, 2–3 videos/week on TikTok.
promotionalIdeas.format: Content pillars: Behind the Scenes, Guest Moments, DJ Sets, Influencer Collabs, Podcast Clips
promotionalIdeas.integration: All content feeds back into event promotion and podcast content engine
promotionalIdeas.notes: Budget: $400/mo for content production. May need videographer if quality demands increase.

promotionalIdeas.name: Paid Social Advertising
promotionalIdeas.concept: Meta/TikTok targeted ads to Boise 21–35, nightlife interests. Awareness → Consideration → Conversion funnel.
promotionalIdeas.format: Awareness (video views), Consideration (traffic to IG/podcast), Conversion (event promotion)
promotionalIdeas.integration: Supplements organic reach. Scales if ROAS positive.
promotionalIdeas.notes: Budget: $300/mo. Small tests first, scale winners, kill losers fast.
